headline: Your no-knead sourdough video passed 4,200 views in five days, more than twice your usual.

waiting.videoTitle: No-knead sourdough in a small oven
waiting.author: Daniel R.
waiting.text: What size is your Dutch oven? Mine is 20 cm and I am worried the loaf will be too big for it.
waiting.reply: Mine is 24 cm. In a 20 cm pot, use two thirds of the dough and bake the rest as rolls. It works well, I did it for years.

waiting.videoTitle: No-knead sourdough in a small oven
waiting.author: Priya S.
waiting.text: Can I use whole wheat flour instead of white? Do I need more water?
waiting.reply: Yes. Swap up to half the flour for whole wheat and add about two tablespoons more water. All whole wheat makes a denser loaf.

waiting.author: Tom H.
waiting.text: The link to the pan in the description goes to a page that does not exist.
waiting.reply: Thank you for telling me. I will fix the link today.

waiting.videoTitle: My five knives, and the two I never use
waiting.author: Harbor Cutlery
waiting.text: We love your channel and would like to send you our new chef's knife. Where can we write to you?
waiting.reply: Thank you, that is kind. The contact address is on my channel's About page.

waiting.videoTitle: No-knead sourdough in a small oven
waiting.author: Lena K.
waiting.text: First loaf I ever made that actually rose. My kids ate half before dinner. Thank you!
waiting.reply: This made my day. Tell the kids the second loaf is always better.
